item.title: 21 years and counting of 'eight fallacies of distributed computing' (2025)
item.description:
📝 The underlying eight fallacies of distributed computing are buried ‘constants’ in our use of the network. The list is aimed at people writing network software: Applications that call into the network, services that are called from the network, and network protocols. Figure 1 — The eight fallacies of distributed computing.

item.title: David Sacks on Anthropic export control
item.description:
📝 — Fable is Mythos with guardrails. It’s been very surprised that Anthropic hasn’t wanted to cooperate with a reasonable safety request (ie fixing the jailbreak issue). It is frankly bewildered that Anthropic hasn’t wanted to comply with safety requests that it previously said were its highest priority.

item.title: The hallucinogenic mushroom that contains no known psychedelic
item.description:
📝 Consciousness Safety General insight Lanmaoa asiatica carries none of the known psilocybin or ibotenic acid biosynthetic genes, yet regional reports consistently describe hallucinogenic effects pointing to an unknown pathway. The mushroom responsible for this bizarre phenomenology is Lanmaoa asiatica. The striking result is that Lanmaoa asiatica lacks any known hallucinogenic chemical signature.
🔗 Read more: https://psychedelics.co.uk/news/a-mushroom-genus-that-gets-people-high-but-not-the
